en.headline: M+ opens Herzog & de Meuron focus display of China projects
en.dek: Models, drawings and material samples from the Swiss firm that designed the museum, including Tai Kwun and Beijing’s National Stadium, are on view in the Focus Gallery from 12 September.
body: M+ has opened Herzog & de Meuron: In Focus in its Focus Gallery on Level 2, showing objects from a donation by the Swiss architecture practice that designed the West Kowloon museum building. The display began on 12 September and is listed as ongoing.

The museum said the selection includes models, drawings and material samples from built and unbuilt work in China, among them M+ itself (2012–2021), Tai Kwun in Central (2006–2018) and the National Stadium in Beijing (2002–2008), as well as urban planning projects. The objects are shown in replicas of the wooden KABINETT vitrines the firm developed for its foundation in Basel.

M+ framed the gift as part of marking its fifth anniversary in November 2026, and as a record of the practice’s work in China since the early 2000s. Co-founder Jacques Herzog is quoted by the museum as saying that because architecture itself cannot be exhibited, the firm is compelled to find substitutes; the open-storage layout is intended to show how projects were developed.

West Kowloon lists the Focus Gallery display as free admission. M+ is in the West Kowloon Cultural District and is typically open Tuesday to Sunday, with extended evening hours on Friday and closed on Monday. Visitors should confirm current hours with the museum before travelling.

zh.headline: M+展出赫爾佐格與德梅隆中國項目模型及圖則
zh.dek: 設計本館的瑞士事務所損贈模型、繪圖及物料樣本，包括大館及北京國家體育場，9月12日起於焦點空間展出。
body: M+於2樓焦點空間開幕「Herzog & de Meuron：聚焦」，展出設計西九M+大樓的瑞士建築事務所損贈的藏品。展覽由9月12日起舉行，館方列為持續展出。
館方表示，展品包括事務所在中國已建成及未建成項目的模型、繪圖和物料樣本，當中有M+大樓（2012至2021年）、中環大館（2006至2018年）、北京國家體育場（2002至2008年），以及城市規劃項目。展品置於仿照事務所巴塞爾基金會木製KABINETT展示櫃的展具內。
M+指這批損贈配合博物館將於2026年11月迎來五周年，亦記錄事務所自2000年代初在中國的工作。聯合創辦人赫爾佐格被館方引述指，建築本身無法展出，因此必須尋找替代物；開放式貯存布局旨在呈現項目如何發展。
西九文化區資料列焦點空間這項展覽為免費入場。M+位於西九文化區，一般星期二至日開放，星期五延長晚上開放，星期一休館。參觀前宜向博物館確認最新開放時間。
